newsitem.title: USA: Insituform sees yr shr at $0.35 to $0.45.
newsitem.headline: Insituform sees yr shr at $0.35 to $0.45.

text.p: Insituform Technologies Inc estimated Tuesday that its earnings for the current year would fall in the range of $0.35 to $0.45 per share.
Last year, the company reported a loss of $0.04 a share. Insituform announced in May it was no longer comfortable with estimates of earnings per share in excess of a range of $0.55 to $0.65.

The company said the estimate was lowered due to increased competition has hurt its gross margins, installation difficulties in the southeastern United States and a charge of $0.05 to $0.10 a share from potential asset write-offs.
Insituform said the value of work it has under contract or is the low bidder totaled $189.4 million at September 30, 1996, an increase from $121.6 million on the same date last year.

In addition, the company continues to implement cost savings actions, including those resulting from product technology improvements and also from our combination with Insituform Mid-America Inc, which we believe will favorably impact on results of operations in the coming year, the company said.
